title: Two-scale neural networks for optimal control of linear convection-dominated equations
summary: We propose a two-scale neural network method for optimal control problems governed by convection-dominated convection-diffusion-reaction equations. Building on two-scale architectures developed for singularly perturbed forward problems, we augment the spatial input with suitably rescaled features that become increasingly important as the diffusion coefficient becomes small.
